edits.old: The DP01 entry, the six views with account_ext, the access rows for DP01 and the retention class come from the RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG synthetic set. The exact composition of the composed DP01 response and the fixture rows are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0341; ASM-0435).
edits.new: The DP01 entry, the six views with account_ext, the access rows for DP01 and the retention class come from the RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG synthetic set. The DP01 entry is composed by reading the P1 catalog API, resolving roles and masking through P4 and reading the retention class from P5; no service copies another service's table. The data_product_access seed holds only the six rows the sources give under version DPA-2026.11 (RW-CASEOWN and RW-AUDIT read DP02; RW-PHONECOL reads DP01, DP02, DP03 and DP05); every other role and product is left to a later approved load through the rwb-case reference-data contract, and no role is granted a product by default. The approved access load arrives as reference data for table code data_product_access through the rwb-case reference-data contract, handled by a handler in rwb-source-data; the service exposes no load endpoint of its own. Criteria and test data read the P1 catalog and access contracts, not the ACE views directly (BR14). The masking rows are not read by table: P1 takes the masking answer from POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise and the FieldMasker interface of RWB-P4-E1037-CON, one hop with a 2 s timeout. The fixture rows are Not specified in the source documents (ASM-0435).
